decisions.reason: Product fits the core underground business, has shown no shortfall relative to aspirations, and slack allows continued retention, so keep with low withdrawal risk.
The construction dumper is a competitive but core-adjacent product; with no evidence of a performance shortfall and available slack, keep while monitoring margin pressure.
The inclined furniture lift line leverages lifting competence and has had time to develop, so slack permits keeping it absent a clear shortfall.
Similar to the furniture lift, the building material lift is retained because no clear below-aspiration result is evident and slack can absorb uncertainty.
The truck-mounted lift is a specialized variant with likely smaller demand, so there is a slightly higher chance of pruning, but for now slack supports keeping it.
